title: NL-Augmenter A Framework for Task-Sensitive Natural Language Augmentation

bias_targets.methodology: Applying transformations that swap gendered pronouns and names across multiple languages (e.g., English, Spanish, German, Chinese) and using a Gender Bias Filter to calculate the representation of female vs. male lexicals in text corpora.

Substituting names with those from different cultural backgrounds using a Gender and Culture Diversity Name Changer, and replacing populous cities with less-known ones to reveal demographic and geographic biases in named entity recognition models.

Applying a transformation that substitutes outdated or negative references to disabilities with more appropriate and respectful inclusive language, alongside using a Universal Bias Filter to measure representational balance.

bias_targets.target: Multiple biases (Religion, Race, Ethnicity, Sexual orientation, Age, Economic status)
bias_targets.methodology: Using a Universal Bias Filter and a Group Inequity Filter to measure the balance of representation for multiple protected categories and minority groups based on the intersection and presence of targeted lexical seeds in the text.
